title: Yext Search Query Response
description: The response body from a Yext Search (Answers) API universal query, containing entity results, direct answers, facets, and search metadata.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for this API response.

errors.description: Any non-fatal errors encountered while processing the request.

businessId.description: The business ID associated with the account.

queryId.description: Unique identifier for the search query, used for analytics reporting.

modules.description: The result modules, one per content vertical returned.

verticalConfigId.description: The identifier of the content vertical.

resultsCount.description: Total number of results available for this vertical.

results.description: The paginated entity results for this vertical.

appliedQueryFilters.description: Filters that were automatically applied to the query.

directAnswer.description: A concise answer estimated to directly address the query.

type.description: The direct answer type (e.g., FIELD_VALUE, FEATURED_SNIPPET).

answer.description: The answer content, format depends on the direct answer type.

relatedItem.description: The entity or item that the direct answer was derived from.

spellCheck.description: Spell check information that may suggest corrections to the query.

type.description: The spell check suggestion type (SUGGEST, AUTOCORRECT, or COMBINE).

locationBias.description: Geographic location information used to bias search results.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate used to bias the search.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate used to bias the search.

locationDisplayName.description: Human-readable display name of the bias location.

accuracy.description: The accuracy level of the location bias (e.g., DEVICE, REGION, PLACE).

EntityResult.description: A single entity result from a search query.

data.description: The entity's field data, structure varies by entity type.

highlightedFields.description: Map of field IDs to highlighted snippets showing query match context.

distance.description: Distance in meters from the query location bias.
